notes.title: Special streaming of Prune & Milo at Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
Don't miss the special streaming event for the new Steam Next Fest! Prune & Milo is a unique turn-based game.

Play the first 15 levels to uncover the mysteries of the strange cave and help Prune & Milo find the exit!

And don't forget to add Prune & Milo to your Wishlist on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2787710?utm_source=jandu&utm_campaign=steamfest&utm_medium=steamevent
